# Inventory at equal fill rate with bootstrap 95% CIs — window w26_c2 (generated by code/equal_fill_ci.py)

Default scenario (L = 2, no liquidation), τ ∈ [0.5, 0.8, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99]; 200 bootstrap resamples of series (seed 2026). 'units' = weeks of demand in units; 'value' = the same KPIs weighted by the weekly selling price (series without price excluded). Δ vs lgb_quantile = I_method / I_lgb_quantile − 1 (positive = lgb_quantile needs less); CI shown only if the target is reached in ≥ 95% of resamples.
